facts.fact: The EAC says experts from the Central Bank of Rwanda and Rwanda's payment operators took part in the 7-11 July 2026 EAC technical meeting on the Rwanda-Tanzania cross-border payment proof of concept.
The EAC says the 7-11 July 2026 technical meeting on the Rwanda-Tanzania payment proof of concept was held in Zanzibar and chaired by Nestory Nicholas Maro of the Bank of Tanzania.
